product_one_liner.value: Lumilens makes photonic interconnects that help hyperscalers scale GPU clusters and build denser AI-compute nodes in data centers.
product_one_liner.notes: Lumilens’s photonic-interconnect page says the products let hyperscalers expand GPU clusters and build denser compute nodes for scale-out and scale-up AI architectures.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage navigation and footer list product, company, join, blog, privacy, and terms links but no pricing page, supporting False under the requested rule.

named_customers.notes: The official homepage refers to top-tier customers but does not name them, and Reuters says the customer under the disclosed multi-billion-dollar agreement declined to be identified. No two Lumilens customers can therefore be named from this evidence.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 164 employees, which falls in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile lists Lumilens’s locality as San Jose, California; the requested city value is San Jose. | hq_country: The company profile places Lumilens in San Jose, California, and identifies its country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile gives Lumilens founded year 2024; the independent optical-industry profile likewise says it was founded in early 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The official News & Insights index has a Blog heading with one blog entry, “Networks Are Now the AI Bottleneck”; the following entries shown are a video and media articles, so it does not show the two qualifying engineering/technical posts required for True.

public_docs.notes: The official homepage’s navigation and footer provide no docs, help-center, or developer-portal link, supporting False under the specified rule.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers board is open and lists 162 positions. Current engineering/data roles inspected are titled Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data, Analytics Engineer, and Data Engineer; those titles do not meet the specified AI/ML/data-science title test, and no qualifying live title was found.

compliance_certs.notes: Lumilens has a public privacy/legal page and a data-security section. The checked policy names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a certification, so the supported list is empty; the Exaforce case-study badges are not Lumilens certifications.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Reuters identifies the latest financing as Series C; Lumilens’s August 2026 announcement gives the date and round funding amount. | funding_date: Lumilens’s funding announcement is dated August 6, 2026, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: Reuters reports the latest Series C as more than $700 million; funding coverage commonly reports the round as $700 million. The numeric value is the rounded reported round size, not Lumilens’s total funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The company announced the Series C on August 6, 2026, which is inside the 18-month window before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Ashby posting is titled Customer Sales Representative, which includes the specified sales-representative title category, and links to an application. Its description concerns customer requests and post-sales work, but the title meets the stated title-based rule.

launched_6mo.notes: Lumilens’s August 6, 2026 announcement says it emerged from stealth and was commercially shipping its first product; the product-launch/market introduction falls within the six months before November 10, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Neera Patel’s LinkedIn profile lists her current title as Chief Financial Officer at Lumilens and a start date of October 1, 2026, within the 12 months before November 10, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Lumilens Business Process Manager job post explicitly labels Salesforce as a CRM enterprise system in its requirements, providing a visible CRM-stack signal. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Lumilens job posting explicitly names Salesforce as its CRM example.
